description:
FILED s536b (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08) while fixing #4309.  PRE-EXISTING on main 0affbe86 and c950ad43.

REPRODUCER (scratch/s536b/p/f2.pl in the s536b worktree; perl 5.40.3):

    my @a = ("XYZ"); my %h = (k => "hQC");
    for my $c (substr($a[0], 0, 1), substr($h{k}, 0, 1)) { $c = lc $c } print "8 $a[0] $h{k}\n";
    my $s = "AB"; my $t = "CD"; for (substr($s,0,1), substr($t,1)) { $_ = "z" } print "$s $t\n";

perl: `8 xYZ hQC` / `zB Cz`.   PCL (base and tree): `8 XYZ hQC` / `AB CD` -- no error, the writes vanish.

MECHANISM (read, not fixed): the k>1 foreach path in Parser2 (_lower_foreach_stmt, `my @el = Pl::Parser::_foreach_scalar_elements(...)`) takes per-element alias verdicts only when EVERY element is a single-scalar operand; a substr / pos / vec CALL element is not one, so the whole list goes through the run-time flattener and each window is a copied value.  The single-element case aliases since #4308 / #4309 (_magic_lvalue_call_head + _alias_box_form -> ExprToCL::_write_through_form).  Shape of a fix: let _foreach_scalar_elements accept a magic-lvalue call element (the same predicate, _magic_lvalue_call_head), so each element is lowered once and swapped by _alias_box_form -- the k=1 rule IS the k=k rule (s369).  Probe the mixed list `for ($x, substr($s,0,1), @a)` too (stays on the flattener; @a's elements alias there).
BAR: the reproducer; a guard row beside #4309's in Pl/t/lvalue-ref-01.t.


=== DONE (s536f) ===
Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08.  FIXED.  The k>1 qualifier `Pl::Parser::_foreach_scalar_elements` accepts a magic-lvalue CALL as one element of a SEVERAL-element list (`_foreach_magic_call_elem_p`: `_magic_lvalue_call_head` + a parenthesised argument list, or `pos $x`), so the list keeps its `(vector …)` shape and each element gets its write-through cell from the per-element alias rewrite (`_foreach_alias_rewrite` + `_alias_box_form` -> `_write_through_form`, the k=1 path's own pieces); VarAnnotator's force-box of the call's target moved into one helper `_ev_foreach_magic_args`, which asks the same qualifier for its elements (no new comma walk).  The SOLE call keeps the whole-list lowering, so k=1 emission is unchanged.  Probes scratch/s536f/p/m2.pl m2b.pl m2c.pl m2d.pl: the reproducer, the mixed `($x, substr(...), $h{k})`, vec, pos, an element target, a `my` loop var, a modifier, a sub-local lexical = perl.  Guard Pl/t/lvalue-ref-01.t row 22 (FAILS on c8886b61).  Residue filed #4684 (a list that also holds an array; a paren-less substr / vec / pos among several elements).


=== CLOSED (s536 reviewing session, 2026-11-08 19:1x) === merged as MAIN-READY-82 b28b8799 (s536f, generation v2-13000, code sha 0ac58419). Review probes perl -> main ce06e1f6 -> tree (scratchpad p536f/a.pl b.pl c.pl, 35 lines): tree = perl on every line; main wrong on 11 and died twice (the read-only s/// on a tied element assignment, an unbound glob after (*g, *h) = LIST). No baseline row is keyed on this task.
subject: A foreach list of SEVERAL magic-lvalue calls -- `for (substr($s,0,1), substr($t,1)) { $_ = "z" }` -- does not alias them: the writes are lost (SILENT WRONG; perl writes both)
